When to Consider Tankless Water Heater Installation

Do you run out of hot water regularly? If hot showers are a precious commodity and something you rush through, it might be time to consider an alternative option for a hot water heater. Tankless water heater installation means putting in a hot water source that never runs out. Since water heats on demand, once you have hot water flowing from the tap, it’s always available.

When your existing water heater needs replacement, it might be a good time to look at your upgrade options. Most hot water heaters last around 8-12 years. If yours is on the upper end, have a plumber from Rosenberg Plumbing & Air take a look. We’ll assess its condition and make replacement recommendations. Tankless water heaters produce endless hot water as long as the flow rate can keep up with demand. If you have a larger home, you’ll need a more powerful heater or more than one to ensure an uninterrupted supply of hot water.
